sloka: सा निःश्वसन्ती दुःखार्ता शोकोपहतचेतना ।आर्ता व्यसृजदश्रूणि मैथिली विललाप ह ।। ५.२३.१०।।।।
transliteration: sā niḥśvasantī duḥkhārtā śokopahatacetanā ।ārtā vyasṛjadaśrūṇi maithilī vilalāpa ha ।। 5.23.10।।।।

translations.english: 'You ought to be the wife of the lord of ogres who has vanquished thirty three crores of gods including Indra, their king.'
